lines.text: Good evening, everyone, and thank you for coming out in the rain.
For twenty years, this neighbourhood has been told the lake cannot be saved and this town cannot change.
We will clean it, plant it, and bring the birds home.
Some people ask, why should we bother?
A lake is not something we own, but something we borrow.
Ask not what this lake can give you.
Ask what you can give it, on Sunday, at seven.
The meeting point is the main gate near the temple, and there will be tea.
Let's show up. Let's get muddy. Let's get it done.
